senses.head: A spot or line on a surface that spoils its appearance
examples: The glass left a ring mark on the wood.
There were muddy marks all over the floor.
The burn left a small mark on her arm.

senses.head: The thing you aim at when you shoot or throw
examples: His first arrow fell short of the mark.
Her guess about the price was close to the mark.
The critics' complaints were wide of the mark.

senses.head: A sign or feature that shows the presence or quality of something
examples: The flags were lowered as a mark of respect.
Patience is the mark of a good teacher.
Hand stitching is a mark of quality in a boot.

senses.head: A particular point on a scale or in a stretch of time
examples: Donations passed the million-dollar mark last night.
He was pulled from the game just before the ten-minute mark.
Water rose above the flood mark on the wall.

entries.русский: след, отметина, пятно; цель, мишень; знак, признак; отметка, рубеж
